Level 2 - Beginner 35 min LLD UML Walmart

Class Relationships: Association, Aggregation, Composition & More

After this page you can look at any two classes and say, in one breath, which of the six UML lines joins them, draw the right arrow end, explain who controls whose lifetime, and write the exact code shape that line stands for. That is the part of a class diagram interviewers actually read.
